NVDA.headline: Nvidia faces mixed news on AI partnerships and a GPU leak
NVDA.summary: Nvidia shares rose 2.54% today to $221.97, though they are down 3.01% over one month and up 19.17% over one year. Reports say Nvidia is in talks to invest hundreds of millions of dollars in AI cloud firm Firmus, and Nokia and SMCI cited its chips and collaboration. A TweakTown report, citing an unconfirmed retail leak, says Nvidia may discontinue the RTX 5090 and RTX 5080 16GB in January 2027; Nvidia has not commented.

MSFT.headline: Microsoft Xbox plans reported, none confirmed by the company
MSFT.summary: Microsoft shares rose 0.2% today to $532.95, up 7.02% over one month but only 1.78% over one year. Fortune-based reports say Microsoft plans a next-generation Xbox handheld in 2027 and Project Helix in 2028, with projected pricing of $1,200 to $1,800, and a possible à la carte Game Pass overhaul. Microsoft has confirmed only that Project Helix will play Xbox and PC games; it has not confirmed the timings, pricing or plans.

AAPL.headline: Apple faces Australian app store ruling as iPhone Duo demand grows
AAPL.summary: Apple shares rose 1.32% today to $343.99, up 1.25% over one month and 30.88% over one year. An Australian federal court ordered Apple to allow alternative app marketplaces and payment options from 1 March 2027, and Apple says it will appeal. Reports say iPhone Duo pre-orders are strong, with DigiTimes reporting a 44% production target increase, and the device launches on 23 October at $1,999.

GOOGL.headline: Alphabet shares dip as Android date error and AI rivals in focus
GOOGL.summary: Alphabet shares fell 1.62% today to $334.76, down 4.67% over one month and up 28.79% over one year. A Google Play system update is showing a 1 January 2027 date on some Android phones, which reports describe as a labelling error likely to be fixed. OpenAI's upgraded ChatGPT Chrome extension increases competition with Google's Gemini, and Meta says its Muse AI agent is entering a scaling phase.

AMZN.headline: Amazon shares flat amid PHP security scramble and Mass Effect show
AMZN.summary: Amazon shares slipped 0.1% today to $262.37, up 2.9% over one month and 17.02% over one year. Reports on PHP flaws say AWS researchers saw exploit attempts before the patch, and AWS has highlighted the risk. Amazon's Mass Effect TV series is reported to be proceeding despite EA's BioWare closure.

META.headline: Meta faces $25B New Mexico penalty; shares edge up
META.summary: Meta shares rose 0.47% today to $697.52, down 5.31% over one month and 5.53% over one year. A New Mexico court ordered Meta to pay $25 billion in civil penalties over Facebook privacy claims, and NPR reports on child-safety issues at rivals in an ongoing multistate trial. Meta's Muse AI agent is moving into a scaling phase, and the company is developing a WhatsApp in-app browser.

AVGO.headline: Google TPU v9 delay reports; Broadcom shares up 1.03% today
AVGO.summary: TrendForce reports, citing unnamed industry sources, that Google's TPU v9 may face delays because Intel's EMIB-T substrate yields were reportedly around 35% in Q3. A tape-out for Google's Compute Die A has reportedly slipped to late October, and a Commercial Times report points to a possible delay to January 2027. A separate Motley Fool item says OpenAI is reportedly raising $30 billion, but details are unverified. Shares are at 337.8 USD, up 1.03% today but down 7.34% over one month and 4.61% over one year.

TSLA.headline: Musk pushes SpaceX-Tesla merger talks amid reports; shares up 3.41%
TSLA.summary: Reports say Elon Musk publicly endorsed a possible SpaceX-Tesla merger valued at roughly $3.5 trillion, with special committees formed and advisers hired, though some insiders reportedly worry about shareholder scrutiny and delays. Neither company nor Musk responded to requests for comment. Separately, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Ukraine's Starlink access is a matter for SpaceX and Musk under a commercial contract. Shares are at 386.47 USD, up 3.41% today, up 2% over one month and down 10.89% over one year.

TSM.headline: TSMC shares up 1.6%; construction pause after fatal accident
TSM.summary: TSMC shares rose 1.6% today to $431.89, down 4.45% over one month and up 46.42% over one year. TSMC is suspending some construction work in southern Taiwan after an accident killed four workers. Reports also say Google's TPU v9 may face delays tied to Intel EMIB-T substrate yields, based on unnamed industry sources.

SPCX.headline: SpaceX shares up 7.8% on first quarterly profit and Tesla merger talk
SPCX.summary: SpaceX shares rose 7.79% today to $159.31, up 2.97% over one month but down 1.02% over one year. The company reported its first quarterly profit as a listed company, of $4.4 billion for July to September, on revenue up 161% to $14.6 billion. Elon Musk says SpaceX and Tesla have set up special committees to explore a possible merger, but no agreement has been reached.
